human.controls: Arrows move, SPACE acts. Match 3 Block Push by increpare: level = seed % 2 of the 2 playable levels; the episode ends when the level is solved.

symbolic.layout: float32[objects][max_height][max_width]: 1 where the object is present in the cell (level.objects bit), cells outside the current level 0; the level is placed at the top-left
